relationships.subject: predicted pain
relationships.evidence_quote: A cluster in ACC, extending into the rostral portion of MCC, was selectively engaged by predicted painful compared to predicted nonpainful stimulation

relationships.subject: predicted pain
relationships.evidence_quote: Here, bilateral AI/midinsula was selectively engaged by pain prediction regardless of ongoing stimulation or action

key_findings: ACC/MCC and insula activation by predicted pain depends on whether voluntary action can alter the upcoming stimulus; MCC activation correlates with motor output.
